english.title: Fail to comply with direction or indication at Manchester Airport given by sign, constable or official
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[on foot,]_
(B)_[driving or propelling a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_

neglected, refused or failed to comply with an indication or direction, namely **(..SPECIFY INDICATION OR DIRECTION..), at Manchester Airport given by

english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 3.25 of the Manchester Airport PLC Byelaws 2024.
